title: There's No One Like Jesus
lyrics: Verse 1:
[G]There's no one, there's no one like J[C]esus
[G]There's no one, there's no one like [D]Jesus
[G]There's no one, there's no one like [C]Jesus
[G]There's no one, there's[D] no one like [G]Him
Verse 2:
[G]I walk I walk, here[C] and there
I [G]search I search, ever[D]ywhere
[G]I turn around, h[C]ere and there but
There's [G]no one, there's no[D] one like H[G]im.
Verse 3:
You came to earth, a world to save
Was crucified then rose again
You've taken all my sin and shame
There's no one, there's no none like Him
Verse 4:
And one day soon, you'll come again
And take us home to be with Him
And we will all forever sing
There's no one, there's no one like Him.
